productBugs.summary: Removing the last identity provider while single sign-on is the only Legal method leaves no staff method and no Administrator sign-in link (the same defect the DOC-032 admin-org and access authors recorded; file once).
productBugs.reproduction: On accs: Legal policy {password:false,magicLink:false,sso:true}; Settings → Advanced → Authentication → Remove each provider. /api/v1/auth/methods then answered legal {"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false} and /auth/login showed only "Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator." TECH-008 keeps Administrator password sign-in as break-glass (instance.ts assertPasswordSignIn still allows it), but the page offers no way in.

productBugs.summary: Removing the last allowed email domain turns off every Business Portal sign-in method, so existing Business Users are locked out (the same defect the DOC-032 admin-org and access authors recorded; file once).
productBugs.reproduction: On accs: Settings → Advanced → Authentication → Business Portal Authentication → Remove helix.example (the only domain). /api/v1/auth/methods then answered business {"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}; /portal/login showed only "Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator." and an existing Business User's earlier sign-in link gave no session. TECH-008 (2026-09-27 addendum) and SET-004 say the list governs new accounts only.

productBugs.summary: Minor: for an account without a password (first signed in through single sign-on), the required two-factor enrollment page says "Confirm your password to start enrollment." but shows no Password field.
productBugs.reproduction: On accs with Legal requireTwoFactor on, the invited Administrator doc032.access.sso.admin.* signed in through Continue with single sign-on and landed on /auth/two-factor/enroll. The page read "Two-factor authentication Confirm your password to start enrollment. Your organization requires two-factor authentication." with no Password field; Turn on two-factor worked without one (two-factor-enroll.tsx renders the passwordHint for every password step, the field only when hasPassword). The guide wording "Enter Password if the page asks for it" still holds.
